The Journey • Est. 2014

From Quizmasters to Curiosity Pioneers.

Bengaluru • 10+ Years of Impact

“Why does learning stop being fun when kids enter the classroom?”

In 2014, two national-level quizmasters and TEDx speakers—Sachin Ravi and Raghavan A.—noticed a striking pattern. While young children naturally ask hundreds of questions a day, traditional schooling slowly turns off that spark.

They started QShala to prove that learning shouldn't be about memorizing static facts for marks. Instead, it should be an active, socratic sport—full of stories, curiosity clubs, real-world current affairs, and friendly team quests.

Over the past decade, QShala has grown into an ecosystem partnering with 250+ premier K-12 schools and 80+ global corporates, impacting over 150,000+ learners across 18+ cities.
